meta.title: Margdarshak
meta.description: Your driving licence, step by step, without an agent. An independent guide for India's learner's licence and driving licence journey.
meta.tagline: Learner se licence tak, bina agent ke.

welcome.title: Before you start, three promises
welcome.promise1: We're an independent guide, not the government. We're not affiliated with MoRTH, NIC or any State Transport Department.
welcome.promise2: We never ask for your Aadhaar number, OTP or bank details. Those are typed only on Sarathi, the government portal.
welcome.promise3: Fees and rules shown here come with their source and the date we checked them.
welcome.simulated: This build uses simulated government data.
welcome.grievance: Questions or a complaint? Contact our grievance officer.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Plain answers about the licence journey, voice & AI tools, and who to contact.
help.voiceBody: Ask questions by speaking in Hindi or English, or use the AI Coach for tests, road signs, and Sarathi errors. It will never book, pay, or submit for you.
help.govHelpdesk: Questions about your application on Sarathi go to the government helpdesk:
help.scamBody: We never send apps (APK files) or ask for an OTP. Payments happen only on Sarathi or your state's gateway.

services.soon: These open one by one in the next builds.

grievance.title: Grievance officer
grievance.body: If something on Margdarshak is wrong, or you want to complain about how we handle your data, write to our grievance officer. We acknowledge within 24 hours and resolve within 15 days.
grievance.board: If you are not satisfied, you can approach the Data Protection Board of India.
grievance.notGov: For your application itself, contact the government helpdesk. We cannot see or change anything on Sarathi.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.body: Margdarshak is an independent prototype by team Chanakya, not affiliated with MoRTH, NIC or any State Transport Department. We design and test it to WCAG 2.1 Level AA and the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW 3.0).
accessibility.canDo: You can use it with TalkBack, VoiceOver or NVDA, zoom to 400%, and turn on High contrast or Reduce motion in Settings.
accessibility.known: Known issues: the voice guide and games are not built yet. We will list issues here as we find them.
accessibility.tell: Tell us about a problem through our grievance officer. We reply within 5 working days.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: This build keeps your language choice and settings on this phone only. It does not use analytics or advertising trackers, and it never asks for your Aadhaar number, OTP or biometrics.
privacy.clear: To remove everything, open Settings and choose Clear this device.

journey.sarathiDownBody: The Sarathi website isn't working right now. Your application is saved on this phone, and your filled-in Form 1A and photo checks are ready below.
journey.watchdogHintUp: Government websites often slow down or stop between 12 and 3 PM. An automatic check (built with n8n) looks at the Sarathi website every 5 minutes. Try a pretend outage below to see how Margdarshak keeps your work safe:
journey.watchdogHintDown: The Sarathi website is not responding. Margdarshak has saved your application on this phone and prepared everything you can do while you wait.

wizard.ageHint: Or enter your date of birth for an exact plan.
wizard.ageWhy: Age decides which vehicles you can learn, and whether you need a medical form. Your date of birth stays on this phone.
wizard.dobStays: Your date of birth stays on this phone.
wizard.yearHint: As printed on your Aadhaar, for example 2007
wizard.yearOnly: My Aadhaar shows only the year
wizard.yearOnlyDesc: We'll plan with that, and tell you which document proves your full date of birth.
wizard.someoneElse: Making a plan for someone else, like your child or a parent? Answer for the person who will drive.
wizard.errAge: Choose an age, or enter a date of birth.
wizard.errAadhaar: Tell us where your Aadhaar address is.
wizard.errBuild: We couldn't build your plan. Nothing was lost. Try again.
wizard.buildClasses: Vehicle classes on one learner's licence
wizard.vehicleHint: Pick all you want. One application can cover more than one.
wizard.vehicleMinor: At 16 or 17 you can learn only a gearless vehicle up to 50 cc, with a parent's consent.
wizard.vehicleWhy: Each vehicle is a separate licence class. Choosing them together now means one learner's licence and one 30-day wait.
wizard.scooterVsBikeBody: A scooter has no gears (class MCWOG). A bike with gears is class MCWG. They are separate classes. Most scooters are above 50 cc, so you need to be 18; the 50 cc class is only for vehicles up to 50 cc.
wizard.stateTitle: Which state or UT do you live in?
wizard.stateWhy: Each state's rules differ a little: test at home or at the RTO, fees, the track. Your Aadhaar address decides whether you can take the online path.
wizard.otherStates: Every state and UT is covered: the central rules (Central Motor Vehicles Rules) plus what we could confirm for your state, each with its source. Partial means some local details still need checking at your RTO.
wizard.aadhaarTitle: Is your Aadhaar address in this state, where you live now?
wizard.aadhaarNoDesc: You can update it first, or apply with another address proof.
wizard.aadhaarNoneDesc: You'll apply with other proofs and take the LL test at the RTO.

for_whom.title: Who is this licence for?
for_whom.why: If it's for a family member, you stay the account holder. For someone under 18 you give consent as their parent.

d.family: A child aged 16–17, a parent or another relative.

member_kind.title: Who are you applying for?
member_kind.why: We use this only to word the screens for them. We don't ask for their name.

parental_consent.title: Your consent as their parent or guardian
parental_consent.why: The law treats anyone under 18 as a child. A parent or guardian must agree before we keep a child's case.
parental_consent.b1: The case for {name} is saved in your account. You can see, change or delete it any time.
parental_consent.b2: Every feature works for them, AI included. You decide each permission in Privacy.
parental_consent.b3: We never use a child's data for tracking, profiling or ads. Sharing and squads stay off unless you allow them.
parental_consent.b4: At 16–17 the licence can only be for a gearless vehicle up to 50 cc, with your consent.
parental_consent.agree: I'm the parent or guardian of {name}, I'm 18 or over, and I agree.

category.title: Which category applies to you?
category.why: Sarathi asks this first. Divyang applicants take a path with an RTO visit and medical certificates.
category.noteDivyangTitle: You have the right to apply
category.noteDivyang: Sarathi's Divyang category needs an RTO visit with medical certificates. An adapted-vehicle class exists. Verify the details at your RTO.

born_in_india.title: Were you born in India?
born_in_india.why: Sarathi asks for your country of birth. We fill India unless you change it.

licence_held.title: Do you already hold a licence issued in India?
licence_held.why: Sarathi asks this on its first form. If you already have a learner's licence, we pick up from there.
licence_held.noteHeldTitle: We can pick up from here
licence_held.noteHeld: Tell us your licence's issue date in My Licence and we'll place you on the road. We don't need the licence number.

office.title: Which office will you visit?
office.hint: On the non-Aadhaar path you take the LL test at this office.
office.why: Choose carefully: you may need to visit this office later. Sarathi shows the same list.

aadhaar_address_match.title: Is your Aadhaar address where you live now?
aadhaar_address_match.why: Sarathi's online path picks your office from your Aadhaar address.

mobile_linked.title: Is your mobile number linked to your Aadhaar?
mobile_linked.hint: Sarathi sends its OTP to that number.
mobile_linked.why: If it isn't linked, Aadhaar eKYC on Sarathi fails. You can link it at an Aadhaar centre, or use the non-Aadhaar path.
mobile_linked.noteNo: Link your mobile at an Aadhaar centre first, or take the non-Aadhaar path with one more RTO visit.

aadhaar_relation_line.title: Does your Aadhaar show your father's, mother's or husband's name?
aadhaar_relation_line.hint: Look for the S/o, D/o, W/o or C/o line.
aadhaar_relation_line.why: Sarathi fills the relation name from Aadhaar and you can't edit it there.

o.no: No, it's blank or shows C/o

aadhaar_relation_line.noteNo: Update your Aadhaar first, or use the non-Aadhaar path, where you type the name with a document that shows it.

personal.title: Your details, as on your proof
personal.hint: Sarathi asks you to type these on the non-Aadhaar path.
personal.why: We keep these on this phone only, to put them in your copy-pack.
personal.vault: Saved on this phone only. Never sent to our server.

form1.title: The health self-declaration (Form 1)
form1.hint: Sarathi will ask you to tick a self-declaration of fitness.
form1.why: It's a legal declaration. The exact items on Sarathi weren't visible to us, so here is what it covers in general.
form1.b1: You confirm you have no illness that makes driving unsafe for others, like fits or blackouts.
form1.b2: You confirm you can see well enough to read a number plate at a distance, with glasses if you use them.
form1.b3: You tell the truth: a false declaration is an offence.
form1.b4: The exact wording on Sarathi may differ. Read it there before you tick.

form1a.title: Do you have a medical certificate (Form 1A)?
form1a.why: From 40, and for transport classes, a registered doctor's Form 1A is needed before applying.
form1a.noteNotYet: A registered medical practitioner fills Form 1A. Sarathi has a 'Find doctor' page for your state.

classes.title: Which vehicle classes are you applying for?
classes.why: These come from your plan. Change them in the class planner.

documents.subAadhaar: On the Aadhaar path Sarathi uses your Aadhaar photo, so you need only your signature.
documents.subNonAadhaar: On the non-Aadhaar path you upload a photo and your signature.
documents.photoHint: Plain light wall, face the camera.
documents.photoAadhaar: Not needed: Sarathi uses your Aadhaar photo.
documents.uploadRules: Upload rules on Sarathi: JPG or PDF, under 300 KB, file name with no spaces or symbols. We make your files fit.

fixer.coachFlat: Hold the paper flat inside the box.

fixer.altFixed: The fixed image, ready to save

fixer.finalTitle: This photo goes on your licence
fixer.finalBody: It will be printed on your LL and DL. Sarathi doesn't let you replace it later.
fixer.neverUploaded: Fixed on this phone. Nothing is uploaded to Margdarshak.
fixer.padHint: Use the same signature you'll use at the RTO.

check.sub: Sarathi won't let you edit after you pay. Check everything now.

check.confirm: I've checked these answers and they match my documents.
check.errConfirm: Tick the box to confirm your answers.

notice.lead: Short, plain, and complete. It explains how we handle your data under India's DPDP Act 2023 and Rules 2025.

who.title: Who we are
who.body: Margdarshak is an independent app by Nestiq Private Limited. It is not affiliated with MoRTH, NIC or any State Transport Department.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Your date of birth and the vehicle classes you choose (to work out your dates and steps), the case facts you enter (like your LL issue date), and an email only if you sign in.

never.title: What we never collect
never.body: Your Aadhaar number, VID, OTP, fingerprints, face scan, bank details or images of your documents. Those steps happen on the government's Sarathi website.

why.title: Why
why.body: Only to show and remind you of your licence steps. No ads, no selling of data.

ai.title: AI help
ai.body: Off until the account holder turns it on. It uses Google's Gemini service. It is sent result and topic IDs, your language, and a screenshot or voice only if you share one; never your contact details, date of birth, Aadhaar, OTP or licence numbers. Google may process it outside India.

family.title: Children (under 18)
family.body: A learner under 18 uses Margdarshak inside a parent's account (family mode). The parent gives verifiable consent. Every feature is available, AI included. We never use a child's data for tracking, profiling or targeted ads; sharing and squads stay off unless the parent allows them.

processors.title: Who processes data for us
processors.body: Google (Gemini, for AI help), Sarvam (Dogri speech to text), our hosting provider, and email and WhatsApp delivery providers. Each only for the purpose above.

kept.title: How long we keep it
kept.body: Anonymous plans 30 days. Accounts until you delete them; inactive accounts after 18 months, with a warning 48 hours before. AI prompts 7 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: See, correct, download or delete your data any time in the Privacy centre. Withdraw any permission in one tap; it stops at once.

complain.title: Questions or complaints
complain.body: Write to our Grievance Officer at {email}. We acknowledge within 24 hours and resolve within 15 days. You can also complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

blocker.under_16: No licence class opens before 16. The earliest is the 50 cc gearless licence from your 16th birthday, {date}, with a parent's consent.
blocker.dob_year_only: Your Aadhaar shows only the year, so Sarathi may treat your birthday as 1 January. Carry a document with your full date of birth. Your dates here use 31 December, so you are never shown as older than you are.
blocker.address_mismatch: Your Aadhaar address is not where you live. Either update Aadhaar and use the online path, or apply with another address proof on the non-Aadhaar path, with one more RTO visit.
blocker.relation_line_blank: Sarathi takes the relation name from Aadhaar and you can't edit it there. If yours is blank, update Aadhaar, or use the non-Aadhaar path with a document that shows the name.
blocker.form1a_age40: You are 40 or older, so you need a medical certificate (Form 1A) from a registered doctor before applying.
blocker.transport_under_20: Transport vehicles need you to be 20. You can apply from {date}.
blocker.ll_expired: Your learner's licence has expired. Apply for a fresh one; a new application number means an old slot won't carry over.

jk.class_vs_vehicle: Pick the class that matches your vehicle. A scooter above 50 cc is "scooter without gears" (MCWOG); the 50 cc class covers only up to 50 cc. A wrong class means a new LL and another 30 days.
jk.address_mismatch: Your Aadhaar address is not where you live. Update Aadhaar and use the online path, or apply with another address proof (non-Aadhaar path, one more RTO visit). How J&K offices handle this isn't known yet: ask at the counter.
jk.relation_line_blank: The father's or guardian's name may come back blank and locked from Aadhaar. Update Aadhaar, or use the non-Aadhaar path with a document that shows the name.
jk.form1a_age40: You are 40 or older, so you need a medical certificate (Form 1A) before applying. The RTO approves it before the LL test.
jk.aadhaar_mobile_not_linked: Sarathi sends the Aadhaar OTP to the mobile linked to your Aadhaar. Link it at an Aadhaar centre, or use the non-Aadhaar path.
jk.home_test_device: The home LL test needs a laptop or desktop with a webcam, Chrome or Edge, and pop-ups allowed. In J&K you can take it at a Common Service Centre instead.
jk.disability_rights_card: Divyang applicants take the path with an RTO visit. You have the right to apply; an adapted-vehicle class exists and you can ask for accessible formats.
jk.photo_cannot_change_later: Check your photo and signature before you pay: they can't be replaced later.
jk.no_test_vehicle: Bring a vehicle of your class to the test, with RC, insurance, PUC and L plates. A driving school near the RTO can provide one.
jk.dob_year_only: Your Aadhaar shows only the year, so Sarathi may treat your birthday as 1 January. Carry another date-of-birth document (birth certificate, Class 10 certificate or passport).

warning.turning_40_mid_journey: You turn 40 on {date}, before your learner's licence expires. If your driving test is on or after that day, you'll need Form 1A.
warning.u18_mc50_only: At 16–17 you can learn only a gearless vehicle up to 50 cc, with a parent's consent. Most scooters are above 50 cc. Other classes open from your 18th birthday, {date}.
warning.transport_lmv_prereq: Other conditions for transport classes vary, such as holding a car licence for a year. Verify at your RTO. An accredited driver-training centre certificate is another path.
warning.aadhaar_mobile_not_linked: The Aadhaar path sends an OTP to the mobile linked to your Aadhaar. Link it at an Aadhaar centre, or use the non-Aadhaar path.
warning.home_test_device: The home LL test needs a laptop or desktop with a webcam, Chrome or Edge, and pop-ups allowed. Without one, take the test at the RTO.
warning.foreign_licence: We found no direct conversion: you follow the LL to DL path. Some RTOs may exempt tests.
warning.moving_state: A learner's licence is issued by a state. If you move, we check your plan against the new state's rules.
warning.no_test_vehicle: You need a vehicle of your class for the driving test, with RC, insurance, PUC and L plates. A driving school can provide one.
warning.ll_expiring: Your learner's licence expires on {date}. Book a driving-test date before then.

kl.slot_backlog: In Kerala a driving-test date has often been 3 months or more after the LL (2024 reports). Book as soon as booking opens.

notice.family_mode: Use Margdarshak inside a parent's or guardian's account (family mode). The adult account holder gives consent, and every feature works.
notice.class_vs_vehicle: The 50 cc class covers only vehicles up to 50 cc. Check the cc on the vehicle's RC: most scooters need the scooter-without-gears class (MCWOG).
notice.sc_lmv_7500kg: Car (LMV) licence holders may drive transport vehicles up to 7,500 kg (Supreme Court, 6 Nov 2024). Verify for commercial use.
notice.ll_test_at_rto: Your state doesn't offer the online LL test. Book an LL test slot at the RTO and bring your documents.
notice.disability_rights_card: Your rights: an adapted-vehicle class exists, you can ask for accessible formats, and the Divyang path includes an RTO visit.
notice.deaf_applicants_advisory: MoRTH advisories say driving is mainly visual; hearing loss by itself doesn't stop you getting a licence.
notice.colour_vision: Colour-vision questions may come up in the self-declaration and sign questions. Ask for a text alternative; verify at your RTO.
notice.nri: NRI applicants use the same LL to DL path with an Indian address proof. Document rules vary; verify at your RTO.
notice.idp_dl_holders_only: An International Driving Permit is only for people who already hold an Indian driving licence.
notice.idp_available: You can apply for an International Driving Permit on Sarathi with your DL, passport and visa.
notice.photo_cannot_change_later: Check your photo and signature before you pay: they can't be replaced later.
notice.adtc_option: An accredited driver-training centre course can replace the RTO driving test. The LL stage still applies.
notice.state_charges_may_apply: Your state may add a service charge or postage on top of these government fees.
notice.partial_pack: We have only some rules for your state. Verify the details at your RTO.

jk.digilocker_equal: Once approved, your DL in DigiLocker or mParivahan counts the same as the card (CMVR r.139).
jk.three_sms_24h: In J&K you usually get 3 SMS after the test (documents, result, approval) within 24 hours.

dl.adtt_fail_rate: About half of applicants fail Delhi's automated track at first. Practise the track layout before your test day.

kl.hpt_in_your_test: Your driving test falls after Kerala's hazard-perception test starts. Practise in Kerala's announced format.
kl.hpt_may_apply: If your driving test is on or after the start date, Kerala's hazard-perception test applies to you.
kl.hpt_stayed: Kerala's hazard-perception test is on hold. Practising hazards still helps on the road.

pb.faceless_services: Punjab's faceless RTO services (Sewa Kendra and the 1076 doorstep helpline) can collect documents and deliver certificates.
pb.ll_extension: Punjab lists an "extension of LL validity" service. Ask before your LL expires.

mh.manual_test: Your driving test is likely judged by an inspector. Never pay anyone for a "guaranteed" pass.

fix.wait_until_16: Until then, road-sign lessons in Learn are open to you.
fix.bring_dob_document: Add a full date-of-birth document to your documents: birth certificate, Class 10 marksheet or passport.
fix.address_two_paths: Choose one: update your Aadhaar address first (about 2–4 weeks), or carry address proof and take the non-Aadhaar path now.
fix.update_aadhaar_or_non_aadhaar: Update your Aadhaar at an Aadhaar centre first, or take the non-Aadhaar path with a document that shows the name.
fix.get_form1a_before_applying: Get Form 1A from a registered medical practitioner before you apply. Sarathi has a "Find doctor" page.
fix.plan_form1a: Plan for Form 1A, or book your driving test before {date}.
fix.mc50_or_wait_18: Choose the 50 cc class now, or wait until 18 for a regular scooter or bike.
fix.wait_until_20: Add it to your plan later; we'll keep the date.
fix.verify_at_rto: Ask at your RTO counter before you apply.
fix.link_mobile_or_non_aadhaar: Link your mobile at an Aadhaar centre, or switch to the non-Aadhaar path.
fix.laptop_webcam_or_rto: Borrow a laptop with a webcam, or take the LL test at the RTO.
fix.ask_rto_conversion: Ask your RTO whether any test can be exempted.
fix.reevaluate_new_state: Make a new plan for the state you move to.
fix.arrange_test_vehicle: Arrange a vehicle with its papers, or ask a driving school near the RTO.
fix.reapply_ll: Restart your LL; we'll reuse your answers.
fix.book_slot_early: Book your slot the day booking opens.

jk.address_ask_at_counter: Ask at your RTO counter which they accept, then choose your path. Tell us what you were told.
jk.use_csc: Find a Common Service Centre near you for the LL test.
